verdict.rationale: LightSprint's docs say it turns Figma designs into working frontend code, builds changes described in plain English, and shows them in a live, shareable preview, so a PM can get a working implementation without engineers doing the build. Engineers still review and merge the resulting PR in Review Hub. That is a review gate rather than an implementation handoff, but it means the PM cannot ship larger features alone, only polish fixes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on proof that Figma-to-code produces production-quality output, detailed docs on the design-to-code workflow, and evidence that PM-driven changes can reach production without an engineering approval step.
